title: Similar-sounding letters listening sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Similar-sounding letters; the four seasons; my mother
source: Seeded from arabic/y4 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: similar-sounding letters listening sheet)
intro: Lesson 13: Similar-sounding letters: س ص، ت ط، د ض، ه ح. To understand how to hear and say four pairs of similar-sounding Arabic letters

questions.q: Say the pair تِين / طِين and give each meaning.
questions.model: Teacher: تِين, light t, the fruit from Surah at-Tin. طِين, heavy t, wet earth. Pupils repeat and hold up 1 or 2.

questions.q: Which letter comes from the middle of the throat?
Listening sheet on the pupil PDF: the teacher says 12 words; circle the letter you hear in each pair, then copy four of the words with harakat.
questions.a: Answers per the teacher's list, for example صَيْف (ص), تِين (ت), ضَبّ (ض), حَلِيب (ح)
questions.model: Teacher says word 1, صَبَاح, and circles ص on the shared sheet.

questions.q: find a word in Surah at-Tin with ت.
say a sentence with both سَيْف and صَيْف.
Back to our ponder: can one sound change the word?
